stem: All containers receive the same programmed irrigation volume, but moisture readings show one bench is consistently drier than the others. What is the best next investigation?
choices: Raise fertilizer EC for the dry bench
Change the cultivar assignment for that bench
Lower the room temperature until all containers read the same
Check emitter delivery, placement, drainage and media distribution before assuming equal programmed volume produced equal root-zone moisture
rationale: Equal programmed volume does not guarantee equal delivery or retention. Irrigation uniformity, emitter placement, drainage and media properties should be checked against measured root-zone response.
